edits.reason: Say explicitly enumerates all three structural points: 'A low, a lower low for the head, then a higher low.' The head is already marked but leftShoulder (the low) and rightShoulder (the higher low) are named yet unmarked. Both are valid point anchors of inverse_head_and_shoulders (leftShoulder, rightShoulder), matching marker kind. place:'below' matches the existing head marker's placement for visual consistency. This also mirrors the regular head_and_shoulders beat, which marks all three shoulders.

noAnchorGaps.concept: Retest of the broken lower line as the short entry
noAnchorGaps.quote: you often get a retest of the broken line to enter short
noAnchorGaps.why: move rising_wedge exposes only upperA/upperB/lowerA/lowerB/breakdown; there is no post-break retest point anchor to mark the retest entry.

noAnchorGaps.concept: Measured target = height of the wedge
noAnchorGaps.quote: The target equals the height of the wedge
noAnchorGaps.why: move rising_wedge has no target (L) anchor, so the projected measured target cannot be drawn/labelled.

noAnchorGaps.concept: Measured target = height of the wedge
noAnchorGaps.quote: Same rule for the target — the height of the wedge.
noAnchorGaps.why: move falling_wedge exposes only lowerA/lowerB/upperA/upperB/breakout; no target (L) anchor exists to mark the height-projected target.

noAnchorGaps.concept: Measured target = height of the pole, measured from the breakout
noAnchorGaps.quote: The target is always the height of the pole, measured from the breakout.
noAnchorGaps.why: move bull_flag exposes poleBottom/poleTop/flagA/flagB/breakout but no target (L) anchor, so the projected measured target cannot be drawn. The pole itself is covered: poleTop is already marked 'pole'.

notes: Verified all anchor names against ground truth via the executed chart-vocabulary map. ACCEPT both inverse-hs marker adds (leftShoulder, rightShoulder) — anchors exist, kind matches point anchors, not redundant, say enumerates them, and they bring the inverse beat to parity with the regular H&S beat which already marks all three shoulders. ACCEPT all four noAnchorGaps (rising-wedge retest + target, falling-wedge target, bull-flag target) — none of these moves expose a retest or target anchor, so they are genuinely undrawable. The 'measured target'/'height of the wedge/pole' is a recurring concept across all six pattern beats but none of these vocabulary moves (rising_wedge, falling_wedge, ascending_triangle, descending_triangle, bull_flag) expose a target (L) anchor; only head_and_shoulders / inverse_head_and_shoulders do, and those are already drawn ('target' level present in both). No fixes needed: head-shoulders, asc-triangle, desc-triangle are complete and correctly anchored. rising-wedge/falling-wedge/bull-flag have nothing addable beyond the noAnchorGaps, hence listed alreadyGood (their existing show is valid and non-redundant). No anchor-validity violations found in existing show items.
